caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a simple and functional design. The chair consists of a rectangular seat, four angled legs, and an upright backrest. The backrest is oval-shaped with symmetrical curves and a rounded top, featuring a small horizontal slot or handle near the top center. All parts of the chair, including the seat, backrest, and legs, are rendered in a brown wood tone, showing a natural wood grain texture. The legs are round and taper downwards, connecting to the seat at an outward angle. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or elements present, and there is no shading or shadow effect under the chair, giving the composition a flat and isolated appearance.
title: Zoar "Peasant" Chair
